description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [Scion's Calling Mode] to the user

description.name: Painflare
description.text: 5/7 single attacks (3.05 each) if the user has Aetherflow II level 0/1+, grants [Wind Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user if the user has Aetherflow II level >  0, causes Aetherflow II -1 to the user

description.name: Ruin IV
description.text: One single attack (16.40) capped at 99999, grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Scion's Calling Mode
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1], smart ether 1 and Aetherflow II +1 when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering five times

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
